# domain-hunter

> Free, open-source, browser-only domain availability checker. No servers, no API keys, no tracking.

This file follows the llms.txt convention: a short, LLM-friendly index of the project.

## Docs

- [Issues](https://github.com/WhiteBite/Domain-Hunter/issues): roadmap and known gaps
- [README.md](./README.md): install, run and test instructions

## Key facts

- Install: `npm install domain-hunter`
- Run: `npm run dev`
- Test: `npm run test`
